gotoUrlGithub.label: Github
gotoUrlGithub.description: Download examples, explore source code, and leave a star.

gotoUrlIssue.label: Create Issue
gotoUrlIssue.description: Create an issue to identify a bug or a feature request.

fullScreenToggle.label: FullScreen
fullScreenToggle.description: Toggle showing the application using the full screen.

themeMode.label: {dark, select, true{Dark Mode} other{Light Mode}}
themeMode.description: Toggle the application styling between light and dark mode.

defaultThemeMode.label: Use System Light/Dark Mode
defaultThemeMode.description: Use the system settings to determine styling for light and dark mode.

enableDarkGrid.label: Enable Dark Grid
enableDarkGrid.description: Allow the grid to render in dark mode if dark mode is being used. This is ensures that the grid will render the colors as specified in another tools (for example Excel).

enableDarkImages.label: Enable Dark Images
enableDarkImages.description: Allow the images to render in dark mode if dark mode is being used. This is ensures that the images will render the colors as specified in another tools (for example Excel). This only has any effect if the grid is in dark mode.

language.label: Language
language.description: The language used for menus, tooltips, and messages. This is your own preference and is not saved with the workbook.

insertDataFromFile.label: Import Data from Device…
insertDataFromFile.description: Import a file and add its sheets to the current workbook as new tabs.

insertDataFromURL.label: Import Data from the Web…
insertDataFromURL.description: Import a workbook from the web and add its sheets to the current workbook as new tabs.

newWorkbook.description: Create a new blank workbook. A workbook with unsaved changes is kept, and the new one opens in another tab.
newWorkbook.label: New Workbook

newWorkbookFromTemplate.description: Create a new workbook from a template.
newWorkbookFromTemplate.label: New Workbook From Template…

showWelcome.description: Show the welcome screen: start blank, open a workbook, or pick a template.
showWelcome.label: Welcome

openWorkbook.description: Open a workbook from the desktop.
openWorkbook.label: Open Workbook…

openWorkbookFromUrl.description: Open a workbook from the web.
openWorkbookFromUrl.label: Open Workbook From Web

saveWorkbookAs.description: Save the workbook to a new location.
saveWorkbookAs.label: Save Workbook As…

protectWorkbook.description: Encrypt the workbook with a password, or protect its structure.
protectWorkbook.label: Protect Workbook…
